invariants.rationale: Method accesses nodes.size and nodes.get(i), which requires nodes to be non-null.
Indentation is typically non-negative in UI tree structures for spacing purposes.
Additional width for plus/minus icons in a tree UI is expected to be non-negative.
size should always be non-negative for a data structure representing a collection.
If the Array is not empty, the first element should not be null for proper processing within this method.
